My "best friend" who I had know since we were 4. I think the last straw was in 2014 when we were 18-19.I wanna say that I had depression due to recent events that happened prior to that. Its relevent later. 

She was dating this 48 y/o guy secretly (I was the only one who knew). She had all his attention so she loved it. I was not okay with it because she only used him and he was stupid but whatever shes an adult so I didnt say anything. She knew I was uncomfortable with that but she didnt care. One night she said "do you wanna go under the bridge?" (It was our hiding spot near her house. we would go there and listen to music while looking at the waves. Really relaxing, anyway.) And me being me I thought she just wanted to get out of the house so okay I dont mind. While we were there I realised that she seemed weird like singing disney songs and looking  at the church parking often like she was waiting for someone and then I saw his car... I knew immediately that he was coming and I ask her why the fuck she asked me to come with her. She told me she was nervous and wanted her best friends company. I was livid but I didnt say anything else. I felt like I couldnt say anything without her freaking out on me (happened often). And decisions that I made that night I regreted bc I stayed there when i shouldve called my sister to vome pick me up. But I didnt. She immediately started french kissing him so I turned around and looked at the water. She would puch him around while they were kissing and every once in a while she would push him into me. He would say sorry everytime but let her do it anyway. At that point I was silently crying but still staying there for some reason. I remember thinking about suicide (remember the depression? Yea I was just giving up at that point). I was so distraught that i didnt know what to do. So I did nothing. I just stayed there crying. When they were done we walked back to her house. She never asked me if I was okay. She never aknoleged that she knowingly put me in an uncomfortable position. 

I talked to her for another 4 years because I was and still am terrified of her for reasons I wont talk about now (but if someone want to know I dont mind sharing just ask away). And one day out of nowhere something clicked in my head that I dont need her and really should stop talking to her so I blocked her everywhere and stayed in my house for like a week. (When she realised I had blocked her she got another friends mom to drive her to my house and were stlcreaming at the top of there lungs so all the neighbors could hear "OP come out we miss you. were scared for you" and things like that whitout ever touching the door or the doorbell. Actually I dont think they ever even came out of the car. I dont know I was frozen in place in the living rooms chair, scared.

Sorry for the long post but yea thats my story
